And I'm friends with the chairman.
of that private equity firm. After we signed the deal, he gave me one of the best accolades that I passed on to my team.
And they're a great firm. You already said, he said, your team is like a pack of wolves. You surrounded my
company. You were talking to me, trying to inspire me to sign it and not talk to anybody else,

He said, I told my team that I want you to be like a pack of wolves.

partners and I'm usually the secondary on deals.

Within the firm, how do you structure that pack of wolves on each deal?

all the participants, a very broad job.

We believe that the individuals should see everything on the investment.
The financing, because of the financing is coming out a certain way, the price may not be working,

Maybe can you model in and add an acquisition?
can you sign that before the deal is happening?
So you kind of are trying to solve this problem of how do you price or win this deal by looking
at everything around it.
And we structure ourselves to get to the point by these small project teams are structured by
software subsector.

financial technology software. Individual identity in cyber. Those teams are responsible from
